root_cause_summary: Two independent defects prevented the E2E resume flow: (1) the checkpoint save hook is missing for the 'interrupted_during_api_call' path, so no row is written; (2) the gateway resume decision method is incorrectly placed at module scope instead of inside GatewayRunner, so the resume prompt never executes.
